canonical_source_graphs.scheme: parse FLS INPUT relative to its PWD; keep only regular repo-internal Git-tracked files; union declared producer authorities; serialize the mapping repo-relative POSIX path -> sha256:<hex> with json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes

review_binding_scan.literal_command:
python -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
root = Path(".")
inv = json.loads((root / "audit/INVENTAIRE_COLLECTION.json").read_text())
ref = "audit/A4_METHOD_REVIEW_DEBT_POLICY.md#decision-a4-method-review-debt-2026-08-19"
rows = []
for fingerprint, record in sorted(inv["anomaly_qualifications"].items()):
    if record.get("decision_ref") != ref:
        continue
    source = record["source"]
    packet = record["review_packet"]
    meta = json.loads(next(line.removeprefix("% META:").strip() for line in (root / source).read_text().splitlines()[:10] if line.startswith("% META:")))
    packet_payload = json.loads((root / packet).read_text())
    rows.append({
        "fingerprint": fingerprint,
        "source": source,
        "source_sha": hashlib.sha256((root / source).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "record_method_source_sha": record["method_source_sha"],
        "packet": packet,
        "packet_sha": hashlib.sha256((root / packet).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "record_packet_sha": record["review_packet_sha"],
        "packet_source_sha256": packet_payload["source_sha256"],
        "method_status": meta["status"],
        "packet_status": packet_payload["status"],
    })
digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps({"records": len(rows), "digest": "sha256:" + digest}, sort_keys=True))
PY
